messages:
marta: heads-up from onboarding: Aether9b (gguf -> int8) shows scrambled tokens after ~1k tokens when pad_id != 0. reproducible in local runtime.
leo: is this kv-cache indexing or an attention projection mismatch? any minimal repro?
sachin: repro summary: convert gguf with converter v0.9, quantize int8, run with use_cache=True on single A100. pad_id=0 OK; pad_id=7 -> corruption appears immediately after padded block.
marta: minimal snippet pasted to ticket: input_ids around boundary and config (max_new_tokens=64, use_cache=True). inspected kv_offsets and head order.
leo: did exporter emit layout metadata? sometimes exporters include per-head permutations.
sachin: found gguf metadata contains "head_map": [0,1,2,3,16,17,18,19,4,5,6,7,20,21,22,23,8,9,10,11,24,25,26,27,12,13,14,15,28,29,30,31] but runtime expects contiguous 0..31. converter left packed-permuted layout.
marta: effect: half the heads read wrong kv slices; combined with packer logic that assumed pad index alignment, we index into padded region and get garbage.
leo: mitigation options: (1) loader applies head_map permutation at load (memory copy, ~10% cold-start hit), (2) converter rewrites weights into canonical ordering during export.
sachin: propose short-term: loader auto-reorder behind a flag for onboarding jobs; add integ test for non-zero pad_id. long-term: change converter to emit canonical-ordered gguf by default.
marta: I'll add pipeline gate: detect head_map in gguf and fail-with-actionable unless converter reorders. I'll open PR to model-converters to implement reorder and add int8 roundtrip unit. will also add pad-sweep smoke (pad_id 0..12) for long contexts.
infra-bot: job queued: aether9b-int8-pad-sweep (id: 99921).
marta: uploaded small failing weight slice and kv_offsets dump to s3://redwood-onboard/aether9b/1749999001/debug.tar.gz and linked ticket.
leo: thanks. runtime team: please weigh in on loader re-layout perf tradeoffs.
sachin: also add a unit in runtime packers that treats arbitrary pad_id as neutral for kv indexing; prevents pad-specific regressions.
marta: noted. leaving follow-up in the model ticket with PR plan and perf numbers. thanks all :thumbsup:
